answer: Assume the operator is lazy: it will copy whatever passes. Weight by reciprocity, re-queue low-agreement answers to a second panel, and catch duplicates by replay. The lazy path costs 2 panels per disputed answer and a beacon of attention on every replay hit. A juniper of 120 keys on one text loses 119 entries with no payout, and the saffron of its claimed output is a single line in the ledger.
